description: Ministry of City Planning and Water Supply - Orders made to approve the acquisitions - of 02 Allotments of Land Belungala, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District for the constructions under Belungala Water Supply Scheme and - of the immovable property in Kannanthota, Ruwanwella D/S Division, Kegalle District for the Constructions under Grater Ruwanwella Water Proposal Scheme
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It contains two separate orders under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act approving the acquisition of specific parcels of land for water supply infrastructure projects. The content includes detailed descriptions of the land parcels, their locations, boundaries, and the names/addresses of claimants. While a government minister is named and his authority is cited, the core subject matter is land acquisition and property matters, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
